categories.main_business_segments: Sunwoda Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in lithium-ion battery research, development, and manufacturing. Its main business segments include consumer batteries (covering mobile phones, laptops, and wearable devices), electric vehicle batteries, energy storage systems, precision structural parts, and smart hardware. The company also engages in battery materials, high-performance membrane materials, automation equipment, and electronic product production and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced lithium-ion battery technologies including silicon anode batteries, fast-charging batteries, high-capacity energy storage cells, and integrated battery management systems (BMS). It employs sophisticated manufacturing processes with high automation levels, intelligent factory setups, and digital twin modeling. R&D focuses on battery chemistry innovations such as high-nickel cathodes, silicon-based anodes, solid-state batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and advanced safety and thermal management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sunwoda serves leading global consumer electronics brands in smartphones, laptops, and wearable devices, as well as major automotive manufacturers including traditional and new energy vehicle makers. Its energy storage solutions target utility-scale, commercial, and residential markets globally. The company’s products are widely used in mobile electronics, electric vehicles, energy storage, smart homes, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with multiple production bases across Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Sichuan, and Hubei provinces. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Vietnam, Hungary, Thailand, Morocco, India, Germany, the United States, and other countries, supporting a global customer base and supply chain.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunwoda operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell and module manufacturing, battery pack assembly, and system integration. It also invests upstream in raw material sourcing and participates in joint ventures for battery material production to secure supply and reduce costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include enhancing battery energy density, fast-charging capabilities, safety, and lifecycle management. R&D initiatives focus on silicon anode technology, solid-state and sodium-ion batteries, advanced BMS, and integrated energy storage solutions. It emphasizes digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, global capacity expansion, and deepening collaboration with key customers for joint product development.
categories.revenue_model: Sunwoda generates revenue mainly through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cells, modules, and energy storage systems. It operates on a product sales model with a focus on large-scale orders from consumer electronics manufacturers, automotive OEMs, and energy storage integrators. The company also earns income from related services such as battery management system software and after-sales support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sunwoda is positioned as a leading global lithium-ion battery manufacturer with a strong presence in consumer electronics and growing influence in the electric vehicle and energy storage markets. It ranks among the top domestic players in China and holds a competitive position internationally. Major competitors include CATL, BYD, LG Chem, Samsung SDI, and Panasonic.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sunwoda reported total revenue of approximately RMB 56.02 billion, representing a 17.05% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 1.47 billion, up 36.43%. The company has shown robust growth in electric vehicle battery shipments (25.29 GWh, +116.89%) and energy storage systems (+107%). It maintains a strong asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 87 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D with expenditures over RMB 3.3 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunwoda emphasizes its comprehensive R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing automation, and high-quality product standards to deliver batteries with superior energy density, fast charging, safety, and longevity. Its integrated BMS technology and flexible system integration solutions provide customized offerings for diverse applications. The company’s global production footprint and strong customer relationships enable reliable supply and rapid response to market demands, differentiating it as a trusted partner in the lithium battery industry.
